final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws AS t, COUNT(*) AS c FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), tot AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS s FROM g WHERE c IS NOT NULL), sh AS (SELECT g.t, g.c, g.c * 1.0 / tot.s AS share FROM g JOIN tot ON tot.s IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT sh.c, sh.share, av.a FROM sh JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > av.a) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - a) AS avg_diff FROM k
